townStudyArea.notes: The official locality geometry is preserved unchanged. The active visitor boundary uses a transparent 200 metre morphological closing to include connected parks, river corridors and green spaces omitted by the statistical built-up-area geometry. This is a visitor extent, not an administrative replacement.
